column1: # Reference games for testing. Columns: game id (engine), folder, source, options (optional).
# Source: one or more git URLs separated by spaces; later ones are fallbacks (git.minetest.land
# refuses GitHub's runners since 2026-10, so VoxeLibre falls back to its official GitHub mirror).
# The folder name determines the game id the engine sees (a trailing _game is stripped).
# "engine:<path>" means a directory inside the engine checkout.
# Options: fixed-order = the game only starts with the engine's fixed mod load order, so
# avanti test never randomizes it there (Asuna loads abdecor without depending on it).
